label: Notify
description: Tells people something happened: who to tell, how urgent it is and where the wording lives are all named here, so adding a notification is adding a node and some wording, never Java.

event.label: Event
event.description: What happened, naming the event a template's wording can turn into a sentence. Falls back to the node's own id when left blank.

template.label: Template
template.description: The path of the notification template folder under /libs/iap/notificationTemplates/ whose wording this task sends.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.description: How soon the recipients should hear about it.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.description: Who to tell: "@creator" for whoever raised the thing in question, or a person or group, expanded into its members when the moment comes.
